[SWS_DM_00280] Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation at Re- sponse Transmission
⌈
On Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation in case
a diagnostic request is currently processed on this Diagnostic Conversation and
Transmit ([SWS_DM_00327]) of the UDS TransportLayer was already called, noth-
ing has to be done by the Diagnostic Server instance. This implies a sent out
response.
⌋

⌈

the Diagnostic Server instance. This implies a sent out response.
⌋
